risk_summary: The disclosure clearly quantifies major COVID-19 effects, including a 65%–70% DSD revenue decline at the pandemic peak, an approximately 45% shortfall thereafter, margin compression, and $42.0 million of impairments. Risk remains elevated due to uncertain recovery, continued expected revenue pressure, liquidity sensitivity, and reliance on mitigation initiatives. Repeated pandemic language and broad uncertainty disclaimers modestly reduce precision, while the excerpt also appears incomplete in places.
